items.requirement: Do not force romance just to advance an optional objective
items.label: 3.1.0 更新
items.gap: No planner gap. There is no device (v301_*) screenshot of the 朋友/恋人 control itself, only Robolectric coverage. (The note about the 3.0.x guide widget showing the walkthrough's romance answers verbatim no longer applies: that widget was removed in 3.1.0, docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19.)

items.requirement: [59] P3R flat cyan daytime / deep-blue nighttime colors
items.label: 3.1.0 更新
items.evidence: WidgetPalette.java defines DAY/NIGHT, and of(night) is at :85-87. The surfaces are p3r_widget_day #0FB1F5 and p3r_widget_night #034572 (res/values/p3r_colors.xml:23-24). Night is selected for evening slots by CardModel.night (CardModel.java:25-26), set from PlanView.night() (Rules.isEvening). CardChromeTest.theSurfaceIsFlatAndTheButtonsAre34dpInside40dpTargets checks both surface colours. Viewed renders: qa_out/v3/widget/plan/social-day-320x200-sdk26.png (cyan) and locked-night-250x160-sdk31.png (navy). On device, docs/screenshots/widget_home.png shows the 晚上 slot in navy. (3.1.0 removed the second, guide widget that also used these palettes.)

items.requirement: [59] Paired right-biased line-art motifs and official-style/logo assets already present (art may now be redesigned)
items.label: 3.1.0 更新
items.evidence: The 2.2 MB of unused character and logo art is gone, and 3.1.0 also removed the guide widget's picker preview with the guide (docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19). android/app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi now holds only ui_art_protagonist.png (the 今天 header art, TodayPage) and widget_preview_plan.png (res/xml/plan_widget_info.xml). ShippedAssetsTest.everyNodpiBitmapIsUsedAndTheDeadArtIsGone asserts that every nodpi bitmap is referenced and that character_day, character_night, character_day_compact, official_p3r_logo_color and the guide preview stay absent and unreferenced. A release build with the guide removed is about 0.84 MB (839,496 B before the other 3.1.0 changes; 3.0.0: 3,192,908 B; 3.0.2: 1,028,444 B), and `unzip -l` lists no asset besides assets/p3r/p3r_rules.json.

items.requirement: [61] Existing fixed-guide widget and progress remain safe alongside adaptive planning
items.label: 3.1.0 所有者要求
items.evidence: The owner asked to drop the old entry completely and cut ties with the old project (docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19; spec docs/specs/SPEC_3.1.0.md §1.3). 3.1.0 no longer carries the 3.0.x copy of the guide: its activity, home-screen widget, progress store, assets and tests are gone, and WidgetUpgradeReceiverTest.theManifestDeclaresOnlyThePlannersComponents asserts that the manifest declares only the planner's activities, the plan widget and the v3 upgrade receiver. The guide's data stays as pinned sources under rules/sources/cn_guides/.
items.gap: The 2.0.0 app (app.p3r.dayplanner.test) is a separate package, so its guide and progress are untouched. Progress ticked in the 3.0.x guide can no longer be read after the update: the 3.1.0 release notes tell players to export it first and to remove an old guide widget from the home screen. Leftover data on the device is not deleted (owner decision O2).

items.requirement: Chinese UI (engineering deliverable; detailed terminology audit is a separate section)
items.label: 3.1.0 更新
items.evidence: The WebView guide page the re-audit examined (assets/index.html) was removed in 3.1.0 (docs/DESIGN_v3.md §19), so the app is the native planner and its widget only. res/values/strings.xml holds three strings, all Chinese (「P3R 规划」, 「P3R 每日安排」 and the widget description). The planner screens (v301_today, v301_settings, schedule, sheets) were found Chinese apart from the game terms RANK, MAX and Lv; GlossarySourceTest checks the string literals of v3/ui and v3/widget against rules of docs/GLOSSARY_zh.md, and MePageTest checks the 我的 entries.
items.gap: No label gap. Latin text left in the UI is the game's own terms (RANK, MAX, Lv) and the P3R and S.E.E.S. marks.
